description: PB-90 is the Regional Transport Office for the Jalandhar-2 sub-division in Punjab, functioning as an Additional Registering Authority. It handles vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits specifically for the administrative areas falling under the SDM Jalandhar-2 jurisdiction to reduce the load on the main PB-08 office.
address: SDM Office, Jalandhar-2, Jalandhar District, Punjab
